finalOutput:
I created `snake_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html`, a single file of about 630 lines with the HTML, CSS and JavaScript together. I haven't opened it in a browser or played it, so none of the features below have been checked in use.

What the file contains:
- **Board:** a 30×30 grid drawn on a canvas. Snakes move continuously in one of four directions and grow when they eat food. Hitting a wall, itself or the other snake ends the game.
- **Controls:** one player uses Arrow keys and the other uses W/A/S/D. A snake can't reverse straight back into itself.
- **CPU snake:** it searches for a path to the food and avoids wall and body collisions. If it can't find a path, it moves to whichever safe square has the most free space around it.
- **Modes:** Human vs Human, CPU vs Human and CPU vs CPU, chosen from a start menu.
- **Score:** each snake's score is shown during play.
- **Game over screen:** it shows the winner and final scores. You can restart with a keypress (Space or Enter) or go back to the menu.

To play, open the file in any modern browser.

conversation.contentPreview: Write a snake game in javascript, css, html in one file. Build a classic Snake game on a 30x30 grid. Add a CPU-controlled snake mode that automatically searches for food. Add the three game modes: human vs human, cpu vs human, cpu vs cpu. Display the score during gameplay. Include a start menu and game over screen. Allow restarting the game with a keypress. Use file name "snake_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html"

toolCallDetails.arguments:
{"path":"snake_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a single-file HTML/CSS/JS Snake game. Requirements:
- 30x30 grid drawn on canvas (e.g. 20px cells, 600x600), dark theme, centered layout.
- Two snakes: Player 1 (green) starts left side moving right, Player 2 (blue) starts right side moving left. Each length 3.
- Start menu overlay with three modes: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU (buttons + keys 1/2/3). Show controls: P1 = WASD, P2 = Arrow keys. In CPU vs Human, P1 is CPU, P2 human uses arrows (also allow WASD for the human). 
- Snakes move continuously on a tick (~100ms). Direction input queued (buffer up to 2), can't reverse into self.
- Single shared food (spawn at random empty cell); eating grows snake by 1 and +1 score (display 10 points per food fine). Maybe keep 1 food.
- Collisions: wall, own body, other snake body -> that snake dies. Head-on collision (same cell) both die. Game ends when any snake dies; winner is the survivor; if both die same tick, higher score wins or draw.
- CPU AI: BFS from head to food avoiding walls and snake bodies (treat tails that will move as free optionally); if no path, choose the safe move maximizing reachable area via flood fill; avoid cells adjacent to opponent head when possible.
- Score HUD above the canvas showing both players' scores and labels (Human/CPU), updated live.
- Game over overlay showing result, final scores, "Press SPACE/Enter to restart, M or Esc for menu". Restart replays same mode.
- P key pauses.
All in one file, no external dependencies."}
